newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish stats office to report quarterly GDP data.
newsitem.headline: Polish stats office to report quarterly GDP data.

text.p: Poland's Central Statistic Office (GUS) will release Gross Domestic Product (GDP) figures two months after the end of each quarter, a senior GUS official said on Thursday.
"We will publish quarterly data two months after the end of each quarter," Bozena Jakobiak, head of National Accounts and Finance Department in GUS told Reuters.
Jakobiak said GUS would revise 1996 GDP figures in early March after preliminary data, released on Thursday, showed a 6.0 percent rise against 7.0 percent growth in 1995. @
She said revised GDP results should not differ more than 0.1 to 0.2 point from the preliminary figure.
GUS first published quarterly GDP data last November.
